The Universe in Three Phases宇宙三相

What if spacetime itself can crystallize? This programme proposes that the universe passed through gas, liquid, and solid phases: light and bosons were born in the liquid phase, electrons and quarks froze into form as the solid crystallized, and gravity is the strain of that solid. Particles, the speed of light, even time itself were not given in advance — they were born, in stages.

如果时空本身也会“结晶”呢？这个纲领提出：宇宙先后经历气、液、固三相——光和玻色子生于液相，电子、夸克等费米子在固相结晶时冻结成形，引力则是固相的应变。粒子、光速、乃至时间本身，都不是预先给定的，而是分阶段诞生的。

Three-Phase Cosmology · TPCG三相宇宙学 · TPCG Proposed by提出者 Winston Y Yan Status: research programme, not consensus状态：研究纲领，非学界共识

 LIQUID · W1

 SOLID · W2–W3

Solid — matter crystallizes固相：物质结晶

The core idea in sixty seconds六十秒看懂核心想法

Ordinary matter goes from liquid to solid as it cools. The cosmic sequence runs the other way: gas first, then liquid, then solid. Here “gas, liquid, solid” do not describe temperature — they describe how entanglement is organized: none at all, then short-range, then long-range topological entanglement spanning the whole system.

普通物质是先由液变固，宇宙的顺序恰好反过来：先“气”、再“液”、最后“固”。这里的气、液、固不是温度意义上的物态，而是纠缠的组织方式——从毫无纠缠，到短程纠缠，再到贯穿全系统的长程拓扑纠缠。

One actor runs through all three phases: the non-integrable phase factor. As Chen-Ning Yang pointed out in 1974, when a particle travels around a loop, its phase need not come back matching — and that mismatch is itself real physics. In this programme, “emergence” means exactly this: the coherent pattern formed by countless superposed phase factors selects the world we see.

贯穿三相的唯一主角，是一种叫不可积相位因子的东西——物理学家杨振宁在 1974 年点明：一个粒子绕一圈回来，相位可以对不上，而这个“对不上”本身就是真实的物理。无数相位因子相干叠加出的图样，就是这个纲领所说的“涌现”：图样选出世界。

The three phases, one by one三相，逐相看

The yardstick separating the phases is ξφ, the phase-coherence length — how far the pattern’s phase stays in step. In the gas phase it shrinks toward zero; in the liquid it is finite; in the solid it grows without bound.

区分三相的标尺叫 ξφ——相位相干长度：图样的相位能在多远的距离上保持“步调一致”。气相里它趋近于零，液相里有限，固相里趋于无穷。

Gas phase气相

No entanglement, no light, and no time — “space without time.” With no time, the speed of light here is not infinite but undefined: speed is distance divided by time, and the denominator does not yet exist.

没有纠缠，没有光，也没有时间——“有空无时”。因为没有时间，光速在这里不是无穷大，而是根本无定义：速度是距离除以时间，分母还不存在。

ξφ→ 0

Liquid phase液相

Short-range entanglement appears. Photons, gluons and other bosons are born as collective ripples of the liquid — born with no rest mass, yet carrying energy. Time emerges at this step, too.

短程纠缠出现。光子、胶子等玻色子作为液相的集体波纹诞生——生来无静止质量，却带有能量。时间也在这一步涌现。

ξφfinite有限

Solid phase固相

Crystallization: long-range topological entanglement spans the system. Fermions freeze into localized, stable configurations, and chirality — left- versus right-handedness — is locked in. We live in the solid phase today.

结晶发生：长程拓扑纠缠贯穿全系统。费米子在结晶中冻结成局域的稳定构型，手性（左手 / 右手）在这一步被锁定。我们今天就住在固相里。

ξφ→ ∞

Note: this is a topological transition, not ordinary freezing — no local order parameter is broken; the entanglement pattern as a whole reorganizes. (The one exception is the choice of chirality, which has a Landau-like character.)注意：这是拓扑相变，不是普通的结冰——没有某个局域的“序参量”被打破，只有纠缠图样整体换了一副组织方式（唯一的例外是手性的选择，那一步带有朗道相变的色彩）。

One substrate, two transitions, three births: W0 → W3一个基底，两次相变，三次诞生

Select each stage to see what was born at that step — and what was not yet born.

点选每个阶段，看那一步诞生了什么、还没诞生什么。

W0 — The substrate: space without timeW0 — 有空无时的基底

Before anything begins, there are only phase factors {W(C)} defined on spatial loops, and an action S[W] that sums over them. Space here is a bare topological arena — no distances, no clocks. Time is not an input; it is an output, computed later.

一切开始之前，只有定义在空间环路上的相位因子 {W(C)}，以及对它们求和的作用量 S[W]。空间在这里只是一个裸的拓扑舞台——还没有距离，没有钟表。时间不是输入，是后面才被“算”出来的输出。

Present已有Phase factors and their superposition相位因子与它们的叠加
Absent尚无Time, light, particles, gravity时间、光、粒子、引力

W1 — First transition: bosons and time are bornW1 — 第一次相变：玻色子与时间诞生

Gas → liquid. The coherent pattern begins to flow. Photons, gluons, and W/Z bosons are born as collective excitations, spin 1, massless at birth. Causal order comes with them — time is born. But gravity is not here yet; its source awaits the solid phase.

气 → 液。相干图样开始流动，光子、胶子、W/Z 玻色子作为集体激发诞生，自旋为 1，生来无质量。因果次序随之出现——时间诞生了。但注意：引力还没有，引力的源要等固相。

Born诞生Light, bosons, time光、玻色子、时间
Absent尚无Fermions, mass, static gravity费米子、质量、静态引力

W2 — Second transition: spacetime crystallizes, fermions are bornW2 — 第二次相变：时空结晶，费米子诞生

Liquid → solid. This is the programme’s signature step: fermions emerge as spacetime crystallizes. Electrons, quarks, and neutrinos freeze into the pattern as localized, stable configurations — the programme names them crystallions. They are not impurities or defects in the pattern; they are a new topological order of matter, mothered by the topological order of spacetime itself. Fermion spin-½, charge, colour, and chirality are all born here, together, as intrinsic labels of the crystallion. The source of gravity appears at this step, too.

液 → 固。这是全纲领的招牌一步：“时空结晶涌现费米子”。电子、夸克、中微子以局域稳定构型的形式冻结在图样里——纲领给它们起了一个名字：晶子（crystallion）。它们不是图样上的“杂质”或“缺陷”，而是时空拓扑序亲手“生”出的新物质拓扑序。费米子的自旋 1/2、电荷、色、手征，都在这一刻作为晶子的内禀标签一起诞生。引力的源也在这一步出现。

Born诞生Crystallions (fermions), spin-½, chirality, the source of gravity晶子（费米子）、自旋 ½、手征、引力的源
Absent尚无Rest mass — that belongs to W3静止质量——那是 W3 的事

W3 — Third birth: mass, and gravity as we know itW3 — 第三次诞生：质量与我们熟悉的引力

The Higgs field condenses here, giving crystallions their rest mass. (The Higgs boson itself was born back at W1 — existing and condensing are two different events.) Mass-anchored crystallions leave a static strain field in the solid pattern, and that strain is gravity as we know it. In this picture, time (W1) is “cheaper” than full gravity (W3): time arrives first, gravity later.

希格斯场在此凝聚，给晶子赋予静止质量（希格斯玻色子本身早在 W1 就已诞生——“存在”和“凝聚”是两件事）。被质量锚定的晶子在固相图样上留下静态应变场，那就是我们熟悉的引力。所以在这个图景里，时间（W1）比完整的引力（W3）“便宜”——时间先到，引力后到。

Born诞生Rest mass, static gravity静止质量、静态引力
Result结果Today’s universe: solid phase + crystallions + strain我们今天的宇宙：固相 + 晶子 + 应变

Particles and gravity: what is fundamental, what emerges粒子与引力：谁是基本的，谁是涌现的

Crystallions — the fermions晶子

The collective name for electrons, quarks, and neutrinos: localized fine structures frozen into the solid pattern. Their fractional charges come from fractional winding — phases like ei2π/3 — and fractional charges must combine into integer-charge hadrons, a topological reading of confinement.

电子、夸克、中微子的统称。它们是固相图样里冻结出的局域精细结构，分数电荷来自分数圈绕（比如 ei2π/3 这样的分数相位），而分数电荷必须组合成整数电荷的强子——这就是“禁闭”的一种拓扑读法。

The graviton — a special case引力子：特殊的一位

The graviton is not a fundamental particle like the gluon. The gluon is a first-order emergence of the liquid phase (W1); the graviton is a second-order quasiparticle of the solid’s strain — as the phonon is the quantum of lattice vibration. Strain is a rank-2 tensor, so its long-wave mode is precisely spin-2, coupling to energy-momentum, fitting general relativity exactly.

引力子不是像胶子那样的基本粒子。胶子是液相（W1）的一阶涌现；引力子是固相应变的二阶准粒子——就像声子是晶格振动的量子，应变是二阶张量，所以它的长波模式恰好是自旋 2，耦合能量-动量，与广义相对论严丝合缝。

Consequence: there is no need to “quantize gravity.” Quantization happens once, at the origin — the coherent superposition of {W(C)} itself. The quantum fluctuations of metric, strain, and graviton are inherited from the pattern, not imposed a second time. At the Planck scale the solid dissolves, and the graviton dissolves with it, as a phonon does at the lattice scale. Programme claim纲领主张

推论：不需要“量子化引力”。量子化只在起点出现一次——{W(C)} 的相干叠加本身；度规、应变、引力子的量子涨落都是从图样继承来的，不必再量化一遍。到了普朗克尺度，固相溶解，引力子也像声子在晶格尺度上一样溶解。

The speed of light: a product of the solid光速 c：固相的产物

c is not a constant written into the universe in advance. It is the propagation speed of disturbances on the coherence pattern — as the speed of sound is a property of a solid. The c we measure today is the solid phase’s c. This also reframes “spooky action at a distance”: entanglement correlations are not faster-than-light signals within the solid, but correlations of the pre-time pattern itself — the pattern is in both places at once; only its ripples are limited by c.

c 不是宇宙预先写死的常数，而是相干图样上扰动的传播速度——就像声速是固体的属性。今天测到的 c，是固相的 c。这也顺手化解了“幽灵般的超距作用”：纠缠关联不是固相里 A 到 B 的超光速信号，而是前时间图样本身的关联——图样同时在两处，涟漪才受 c 的限制。

“c is not the universe’s bottom line; it is a product of the solid phase. Spooky is not faster-than-light; it is pre-time.”

“c 不是宇宙的底线，是固相的产物；spooky 不是超光速，是前时间。”

“Topology is the manifestation of waviness — and topology itself is quantization.”“拓扑是波动性的表现，拓扑本身就是量子化。”

Why do discrete numbers — integer charges, winding numbers, Chern numbers — emerge from continuous waves? Because a wave travelling around a loop must rejoin itself: its phase can only differ by whole multiples of 2π. An integer winding cannot be continuously “untwisted” back to zero — that is the source of topological stability, and the reason the solid pattern needs no second quantization: its topological invariants are quantum from birth.

为什么离散的数（整数电荷、绕数、陈数）会从连续的波里冒出来？因为波绕一圈必须接回自己：相位只能差 2π 的整数倍。整数绕数没法被连续地“拧”回零——这就是拓扑稳定性的来源，也是为什么固相图样不需要再被量子化一次：它的拓扑不变量生来就是量子的。

Black holes run the film backwards黑洞：相变的逆行者

Inside a black hole, the transitions run in reverse — solid → liquid → gas — settling into a W0-like gaseous “seed”: space without time, able to lie dormant indefinitely. A seed does not ignite itself; it needs a nucleation trigger. Certain black-hole merger events are proposed as igniters — and a child universe’s Big Bang is precisely that ignition moment. Hypothesis假说

在纲领中，黑洞内部把相变倒着走：固 → 液 → 气，最终沉降为一个 W0 式的气相“种子”——有空无时，可以长期休眠。种子不会自动点火；它需要一次成核触发。某些黑洞并合事件被提出为“点火器”：子宇宙的大爆炸，就是点火的那一刻。

A testable-direction corollary follows: not every black hole births a universe — the parent’s merger rate is the child’s birth rate.

由此得到一个可检验方向的推论：不是每个黑洞都生出宇宙——母宇宙的并合率，就是子宇宙的出生率。

An analogy from condensed matter: three doors一个来自凝聚态的类比：三扇门

The edifice of modern condensed-matter phases has roughly three doors. Understanding them shows why this programme places the universe behind the third.

现代凝聚态物理的物态大厦大致有三扇门。看懂这三扇门，就能看懂为什么三相纲领把宇宙放在第三扇门里。

Door 1 — Pure Landau门一 · 纯朗道

Symmetry breaking with a local order parameter: superfluids, conventional superconductors, ordinary melting and freezing.

对称性破缺 + 局域序参量。超流、常规超导、普通的固液相变都走这扇门。

Door 2 — Symmetry-protected门二 · 拓扑保护的朗道

Short-range entanglement. Most topological insulators and semimetals live here: their bands carry topological invariants, but there is no fractionalization — they remain protected by global symmetries.

短程纠缠。绝大多数拓扑绝缘体、拓扑半金属走这扇门：能带有拓扑不变量，但没有分数化，本质上仍由全局对称性保护。

Door 3 — Pure topological order门三 · 纯拓扑序

Long-range entanglement with local order parameters abandoned entirely: the fractional quantum Hall effect and quantum spin liquids, driven by anyon excitations. The spacetime of the three-phase programme stands behind this door — its crystallization is a topological transition, and string-net condensation is its condensed-matter cousin.

长程纠缠，彻底丢弃局域序参量：分数量子霍尔效应、量子自旋液体，靠任意子激发驱动。三相纲领的时空走的正是这扇门——结晶是拓扑相变，弦网凝聚是它的凝聚态近亲。

Incidentally, cuprate high-temperature superconductors have resisted theory for decades, on this classification, because they stand with one foot in Door 1 (macroscopic charge condensation) and one in Door 3 (the pseudogap side) — two languages fighting inside one material. (The proposer’s interpretation, not consensus.)顺带一提：铜氧高温超导之所以三十多年理论混战，按这个分类是因为它一脚踩门一（宏观电荷凝聚）、一脚踩门三（伪能隙一侧）——两种语言在同一样品里打架。（此为提出者的解读，非学界共识。）

The honest boundary: what is not yet solved诚实的边界：还没解决的问题

A new theory need not answer everything — but it must label which claims are established, which are hypotheses, and which are still blank. The proposer sets the programme’s verdict bar in one line: three numbers, one action — in the end, numbers such as the fine-structure constant α ≈ 1/137 must be calculated from a single action S[W], not inserted as inputs.

一个新理论不需要解决所有疑问——但它必须标清哪些是主张、哪些是假说、哪些还是空白。这个纲领的验收标准被提出者定为一句话：三个数，一个作用量——最终要从一个作用量 S[W] 里算出像精细结构常数 α ≈ 1/137 这样的数，而不是把它们当作输入塞进去。

Has S[W] been written down explicitly?S[W] 的显式形式写出来了吗？

Not yet. A v0.1 loop-gas draft exists as a template, with quantum weights deferred to a later version. This is the programme’s largest open item. Open开放问题

还没有。已有一个 v0.1 的环气体（loop-gas）草案作为模板，量子权重留待后续版本。这是全纲领最大的开放项。

Is the bridge from {W(C)} to the metric built?从相位环 {W(C)} 到度规（引力）的桥搭好了吗？

Not yet. The W(C) → metric map is the key gap in the emergence of gravity; spin-2 is currently a low-energy consistency requirement, not a completed derivation. Open开放问题

还没有。这条 W(C) → 度规的映射是引力涌现的关键缺口；自旋 2 目前是低能一致性要求，而非已完成的推导。

What are dark matter and dark energy here?暗物质和暗能量在这个图景里是什么？

The ontology is deliberately left open. One internal hypothesis is “one source, three streams”: crystallization fluctuations divide into winding, localized structures (ordinary matter), non-winding localized structures (mass without charge — a dark-matter candidate), and never-materialized wandering patterns (a dark-energy candidate), reading the 5% / 27% / 68% cosmic budget as crystallization branching ratios. Dark energy has a second proposed lineage: massless bosons born at W1 that bypass both W2 and W3. Both are hypotheses, awaiting tests such as the Bullet Cluster and the CMB power spectrum. Hypothesis假说

本体未定，保持开放。纲领内部有一个“同源三流”的假说：结晶涨落分三股——带圈绕的局域结构成为普通物质，无圈绕的局域结构（有质量、无电荷）成为暗物质候选，从未物质化的游荡图样成为暗能量候选；5% / 27% / 68% 的宇宙组分比被读作结晶的分支比。暗能量另有一条谱系：W1 诞生、绕过 W2 与 W3 的无质量玻色子。两说均为假说，等待子弹星系团、CMB 功率谱等检验。

Can the programme be falsified?这个纲领能被证伪吗？

Yes, in a definite direction: if c is emergent, Lorentz invariance is only approximate, and high-energy photons should show dispersion — already constrained beyond the Planck scale by Fermi-LAT observations of gamma-ray bursts. If the programme is wrong, this is where it should show first. Testable可检验

有明确的方向：c 若是涌现的，洛伦兹不变性就只是近似的，高能光子应出现色散——这正被费米卫星对伽马暴的观测以超过普朗克尺度的精度约束着。纲领若错，会先在这里露馅。

How to read this site: This is the public edition, presenting a research programme in progress (TPCG — Three-Phase Cosmology of Gauge/Gravity), not established scientific consensus. Established background physics (non-integrable phase factors, topological order, the Higgs mechanism) is labelled separately from the programme’s own claims and hypotheses wherever possible; items marked “hypothesis / open” have not yet passed peer review.

如何读这个网站：本页是公开科普版，介绍的是一个正在发展中的研究纲领（TPCG，三相规范/引力宇宙学），不是已确立的科学共识。文中已确立的背景物理（如不可积相位因子、拓扑序、希格斯机制）与纲领自己的主张、假说已尽量分别标注；标注为“假说 / 开放问题”的部分，尚未经过同行评议的检验。

纲领提出者：Winston Y Yan（普林斯顿大学物理学博士，凝聚态实验物理）。工作题名：《Emergence in Three Phases: A Coherence-Pattern Cosmology from Non-Integrable Phase Factors》（三相涌现：源于不可积相位因子的相干图样宇宙学）。

In one line: waves are the foundation, and phase factors drive every layer of emergence — fermions emerge as spacetime crystallizes.

一句话版本：波是根基，相位因子驱动每一层涌现——时空结晶涌现费米子。
